Context: Medical claims requiring opinion of specialists

- OM, dated 1-5-2018.
1. In chronic cases where diagnosis has been made and line of treatment has been decided by the Specialist of CGHS / Government I empanelled hospital, there is no need to refer the patients just for extension of validity period of prescription. The prescriptions in such cases may be repeated by the concerned doctor of CGHS Wellness Centre.
- 2.
